BiblicalUsage: 1) to be born first; 1a) (Piel); 1a1) to bear early, new fruit; 1a2) to give the right of the firstborn; 1a2a) to make as firstborn; 1a2b) to constitute as firstborn; 1b) (Pual); 1b1) to be born a firstling; 1b2) to be made a firstling; 1c) (Hiphil) one bearing her first child
